post.description:
Always 202 with the same body: a known e-mail gets an "account exists" mail instead.

Finish with ``POST /v1/auth/verify-email``, which returns the first token pair.

Restore an account that is pending deletion: the ticket from the login answer plus the
one-time code mailed with it. Returns a new token pair.

patch.description:
The owner sets ``role`` (with ``disclosure_version``); the grantee sets
``notify_missed``. Never both. ``guardian`` is not grantable here (409
``guardian_requires_invite``).

delete.description:
Request deletion; requires the current password.

Nothing is erased yet: the account is pending for ``ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS`` and can
be restored (``POST /v1/auth/restore``); an hourly job then erases it. Relatives lose
access at once and every session ends.

get.description: What the app gates behind soft limits (TZ §1); limits are null while the flag is off.

delete.description: Owner-only delete (ADR 0005); an archive is purged instead (D1).

get.description: Changes after ``cursor`` with the current state and conflict key of each entity.

post.description:
Changes after each scope's cursor, with the caller's role-projected view.

``scopes`` lists every scope the caller can access; ``changes`` come only for the
scopes in ``cursors`` (the client adds new ones at cursor 0). Requested scopes the
caller cannot access are in ``revoked``: never-existed and foreign look the same.
